variants.name: M903 SLAP
variants.info:
Nothing can stop you now.
Saboted light armor penetrator rounds made specifically to penetrate as many walls of armor as physically possible. Reduces overall damage, but up bullet speed and penetration.

variants.name: .17 Incinerator
variants.info:
Why would you do this...?

Wildcat .50 BMG cartridge made to fire a tiny little .17 caliber bullet.
The speed of the bullet is unmatched.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Rat Shot
variants.info:
So instead of using standard .50 BMG rounds, you are using .50 BMG rat shot. Why would you load your rifle with rat shot? What kind of rats are you against?
I don't see really big rats...

variants.name: .416 Barrett
variants.info:
Proprietary bottlenecked centrefire rifle cartridge designed in 2005. It is an alternative to the .50 BMG cartidge.
Faster muzzle velocity but reduced range effectiveness.
